narrative:
## Handover Summary — Pricing & Channel Mix

Price changes and mix targets are approved by product and market.

## Key Decisions
• Enterprise SMS indexation + international-origin surcharge
• WhatsApp conversation bundles with platform fee in Central Europe
• Western Europe campaign deals repriced or moved to RCS at renewal

## Recommendation for Opex & Platform Cost
With GP secured, the EBITDA conversion depends on platform cost. Prioritise the MyLINK CORE consolidation of legacy messaging platforms.

## Risk Factors
• Price elasticity in mid-market segments
• Competitive responses from global CPaaS players

signals.title: Meta moves WhatsApp Business to per-message pricing
signals.excerpt: Utility and authentication templates billed per message from July 2025; marketing templates repriced by market.

signals.title: MyLINK CORE — Group Strategy Update
signals.excerpt: Group ambition: double-digit gross profit growth driven by conversational channels, verification and platform revenue on a consolidated MyLINK CORE stack.
